purpose: Track whole-manufacturer catalog completeness separately from model-level evidence depth.

states.unreviewed: No whole-manufacturer historical audit has been completed.
states.partial_map: Useful model or lineage work exists, but a complete historical/product-family reconciliation has not been completed.
states.audit_in_progress: A whole-manufacturer audit is actively reconciling history, aliases, regions, bundles, adjacent products, and acquisition evidence.
states.lineage_reconciled: A dated whole-manufacturer audit has reconciled known product identities into canonical, adjacent, registry, or non-product outcomes.
states.monitored: Lineage-reconciled and included in ongoing manufacturer/source monitoring.

policy.rule: Any exact Maker value reaching three canonical GLS rows must map to a manufacturer family in this ledger. A lineage chapter alone does not imply a completed historical audit.
audit_dimensions: manufacturer model numbers and regulatory identifiers

families.label: Rokid
families.notes: Historical audit exposed Air Pro, Max Pro and Glass 3 omissions and routed X-Craft to adjacent wearables.

families.label: RayNeo / TCL / Thunderbird
families.notes: High-risk naming transition across TCL NXTWEAR, Thunderbird/RayNeo, Air, X, V3, iO and GT branches.

families.label: Epson Moverio
families.notes: Long consumer/enterprise chronology with standalone Android, tethered display and industrial head-worn branches.

families.label: VITURE
families.notes: Fast-moving display-glasses family with One, Pro, Luma, Beast, current Pro 2 and branded collector editions.

families.label: INMO
families.notes: Air, GO and photography-focused X branches require reconciliation; INMO X 2024 is admitted while the 2021 X relationship remains unresolved.

families.label: Innovative Eyewear / Lucyd
families.notes: Historical Loud products, Lyte generations, Armor and licensed fashion collections require hardware-generation versus frame-style separation.

families.label: Meta eyewear
families.notes: Wave 02 found no missing electronics generation; Fury and Starfire/Kylie resolve as Meta Glasses frame styles rather than duplicate GLS identities.

families.label: XREAL / Nreal
families.notes: Wave 02 reconciled the Nreal-to-XREAL family and admitted ROG XREAL R1 while keeping Beam, Eye, hubs and docks as ecosystem components.

families.label: Vuzix
families.notes: Wave 02 recovered the missing M920/AV/Wrap/STAR consumer display-eyewear era plus M400-C; Tac-Eye, M2000AR, iWear Video Headphones and Smart Swim route to adjacent wearables; M3000/B3000/AR3000/M300-C remain explicit holds.

families.label: Snap Spectacles
families.notes: Wave 02 certified the six-generation lineage; Nico and Veronica resolve as Spectacles 2/model 002 frame variants.

families.label: Solos
families.notes: Wave 02 reconstructed two pre-AirGo HUD generations, AirGo 1 and current AirGo A5, separating the sport-HUD and display-free AirGo architectures.

families.label: Amazon Echo Frames
families.notes: Three Echo Frames generations plus Carrera implementation merit a formal lineage chapter.

families.label: Bose Frames
families.notes: Five canonical styles across two electronics generations; model-family research exists but lineage certification does not.

families.label: Huawei smart eyewear
families.notes: Audio eyewear and Vision Glass are materially different branches.

families.label: Xiaomi smart eyewear
families.notes: Audio, camera/display and AI-camera branches need a formal manufacturer chapter.

families.label: RealWear
families.notes: Enterprise procurement history is at elevated archival-risk.

families.label: Iristick
families.notes: Multiple enterprise generations warrant a dedicated historical audit.

families.label: Lenovo smart glasses
families.notes: ThinkReality and Legion branches must not be conflated.

families.label: Dymesty
families.notes: Three named retail products plus OEM comparisons require a formal lineage pass.

families.label: CORNMI NeoVista
families.notes: Four canonical NeoVista models were admitted in the display-glasses audit; whole-manufacturer historical completeness has not yet been certified.

families.label: Brilliant Labs
families.notes: Population ledger explicitly covers Monocle, Frame and Halo boundaries.

families.label: HeyCyan / Goodway OEM ecosystem
families.notes: Population ledger separates software, hardware, OEM and retail-rebrand evidence.

families.label: Google Glass
families.notes: Explorer and Enterprise generations preserved; future Android XR partner eyewear remains a separate platform investigation.

families.label: NuEyes
families.notes: Completed lineage packet reconciled canonical and unresolved historical devices.

families.label: Chamelo
families.notes: Completed lineage packet.

families.label: ThirdEye
families.notes: X-series eyewear reconciled separately from adjacent MIDAS.
